analysis.title: TechnipFMC Plc (FTI): 3Q26 First Take: EBITDA Beat on Better Margins, Though 3Q Orders Softer; Solid 2027 Order Guide
key_insights: FTI reported 3Q26 adjusted EBITDA (ex FX) of $636 mil, 5% above GS estimate of $608 mil and 5% above FactSet consensus of $605 mil.
3Q26 revenue was $2,896 mil, 3.8% above GS estimate of $2,791 mil, driven by Subsea Technologies (+4.1% vs GS) and Surface Technologies (+1.0% vs GS). Revenue rose 9.4% y/y.
Total EBITDA margin was 22.0% vs GS 21.8% and street 21.7%. Subsea margin was 23.5% vs GS 23.3%, and Surface margin was 18.0% vs GS 17.4%.
Free cash flow for the quarter was $470 mil vs GS estimate of $279 mil and consensus of $367 mil. FTI repurchased $320 mil of shares in 3Q.

Total inbound orders were $2,319 mil, with Subsea orders of $2,052 mil, 17-18.5% below GS estimates, implying a book to bill of 0.88x. Subsea orders were down 13.9% y/y and up 14.5% q/q. Subsea backlog ended the quarter at $15,487 mil.
FY26 Subsea revenue guidance was raised slightly to $9.6-9.8 bil. The Subsea EBITDA margin guide of 21-22% was unchanged, and the Surface Technologies guide was reiterated.
FY26 free cash flow guidance was raised slightly to $1.45-1.55 bil from $1.3-1.45 bil.
Preliminary FY27 Subsea guidance is revenue of $10-10.4 bil and EBITDA margin of 22.5-24.0%. The company expects inbound Subsea orders over the next five quarters of at least $14.5 bil.
Adjusted EPS was $1.05 vs GS estimate of $0.87 and $0.75 a year earlier. Adjusted net income was $419 mil, 20.2% above GS, helped by income taxes of $104 mil vs GS $151 mil.

GS rates FTI Buy with a 12-month price target of $81 vs a $71.40 price on 28 Oct 2026 close, 13.4% upside. Target is based on an average of a 10.0x through-cycle (2027-2031) EV/EBITDA and a 7.0% through-cycle FCF yield.

market_movers.rationale: 3Q26 EBITDA, margins and free cash flow beat GS, and the 2027 Subsea guide and five-quarter order outlook of at least $14.5 bil were solid, though 3Q Subsea orders missed GS.
